name: Shandong Kehui Power Automation Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Kehui Power Automation Co.,Ltd. is a company that specializes in the manufacturing and global distribution of sophisticated fault location devices for both cables and transmission lines. Beyond these core offerings, their comprehensive product range extends to encompass power cable fault testing systems, sophisticated monitoring solutions for transmission line malfunctions, automated power distribution infrastructure, railway power automation technologies, and switched reluctance motors. Established in 1991, the company maintains its headquarters in Zibo, China.
